_about: Characters made with the Tripo API (see generate.mjs). style is added to every prompt so the cast matches. Up to 5 animations each (billed per animation). rigType: leave out to let rig-check decide. fromTask: reuse an existing model task (no new generation). rigModel: v3.0 (default, 11 presets) or v1.0 (biped only, 90+ presets prefixed preset:biped:).
style: stylised-realistic fantasy game character, full body, clean readable silhouette, hand-painted PBR-style textures

warrior.prompt: bearded human warrior, teal tunic with silver embroidery, light steel armour on shoulders forearms and shins, short red shoulder mantle, leather belt, armoured boots, standing in T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, open empty hands, no weapon, no cape

warrior_v1.prompt: (re-rig of the warrior with the v1.0 rig, for its larger animation library)
